notes: Original Schedule TO-I (not an amendment) for Eaton Vance Floating-Rate Income Trust (EFT): offer for up to 50% (19,931,845) of common shares at 99% of NAV struck at the NYSE close on the expiration date, expiring 2021-07-30 unless extended. commencement_date is taken from the Offer to Purchase date (June 29, 2021); the filing does not state an explicit 'commences on' date. Conditions mapped from Section 13: delisting -> listing; RIC qualification -> ric_or_tax_status; senior-securities asset coverage -> other; legal action -> legal_injunction; trading suspension (also banking moratorium and credit limitation, same category) -> market_disruption; Board fiduciary-duty determination -> board_discretion. The Offer was also conditioned on certification of shareholder approval of a new advisory agreement after Morgan Stanley's acquisition of Eaton Vance Corp.; that condition was met on May 12, 2021 before the offer, so shareholder_approval is not listed. trigger_origin: the Offer was authorised under an agreement between EVM and Saba (activist) following Saba's proxy contest over the new advisory agreement; it is also tied to the adviser change. A second event is recorded because the filing describes three Subsequent Conditional Tender Offers (Q4 of 2022, 2023, 2024; up to 10% at 98% of NAV if the January-to-August VWAP-based average discount exceeds 10%); the window is stated only as months ('from January to August of that year'), so window_start and window_end are null. The filing states this Offer to Purchase does not relate to those conditional offers. Excerpt ends in the Letter of Transmittal instructions; no results are reported.
